operatingRules: Never redo VERIFIED_DONE work unless new evidence contradicts it.
Never convert historical evidence into current verification.
Never invent credentials, IDs, timestamps, signatures, policy IDs, execution IDs or acceptance results.
Every new work session starts by reading this manifest and reconciling only changed or stale items.
When an item is completed, update its state and evidence in the same coherent change.
When blocked, record the exact blocker and continue with independent work instead of repeating completed setup.
